snapshot.text: Public system with 207 hospitals and 2,033 health centres for a large, mostly rural population and many refugees. Dengue, guinea worm and malnutrition are recurring challenges.

priorities.title: Dengue response
priorities.text: The health minister visited N'Djamena hospitals during the dengue response in November 2026.

priorities.title: Guinea worm eradication
priorities.text: The minister led a mission against guinea worm in Salamat province.

priorities.title: Sector steering restored
priorities.text: The health sector's joint steering meeting resumed after four years.
